meta.title: 35岁求职越来越难？五个破局关键
meta.title_en: Why Job-Hunting Gets Harder at 35 and How to Break Through

scenes.context: 讲者拆解 35 岁求职难的第一个原因：高不成低不就的定位困境。
sentences: 35岁以上的小伙伴，找工作真的是越来越难。
People over 35 really are finding it harder and harder to land a job.
找工作越来越难：finding it harder to land a job
低层级低薪资的岗位自己看不上，还有一堆小年轻抢。
They look down on low-level, low-pay roles, which younger candidates are snapping up anyway.
小年轻抢：younger candidates snapping up
好的公司机会吧，公司更愿意找年轻的人。
As for good opportunities, companies would rather hire younger people.
更愿意找年轻人：would rather hire younger people
paraphrase: 低不成、高不就 → 卡在不上不下
Stuck between roles they don't want and roles they can't get.
求职难的第一步 → 是定位问题
The first barrier isn't age, it's positioning.
scenes.speak: People over 35 really are finding it harder and harder to land a job. They look down on low-level, low-pay roles, which younger candidates are snapping up anyway. As for good opportunities, companies would rather hire younger people.

scenes.context: 讲者给出 35 岁求职难的第二、三个原因：职场偏见与公司对投入度的担忧。
sentences: 公司普遍认为，35岁以上的思维方式和工作习惯已成定式。
Companies assume people over 35 have already settled into fixed mindsets and habits.
已成定式：settled into fixed ways
这个年龄段多半已成家，家里会分散不少工作精力。
Most people this age have families, which drains a lot of energy from work.
分散精力：drain energy from work
体力也不如从前，加班熬夜出差拼不过年轻人。
Their stamina isn't what it used to be—they can't outwork younger people on overtime or business trips.
拼不过：can't outwork
paraphrase: 偏见 = 默认 35+ 不再成长
Bias assumes people over 35 have stopped growing.
担忧 = 投入与回报的权衡
The concern is really about return on investment.
scenes.speak: Companies assume people over 35 have already settled into fixed mindsets and habits. Most people this age have families, which drains a lot of energy from work. Their stamina isn't what it used to be—they can't outwork younger people on overtime or business trips.

scenes.context: 讲者给出破局方法：调整心态、改变渠道、降低预期、换赛道、打磨简历。
sentences: 调整好心态，坦然面对现实，这个年龄段的人都在经历。
Adjust your mindset and face reality—everyone in this age group is going through it.
坦然面对：face reality
改变求职渠道，千万不要去海投，方法不对努力白费。
Change your job-search channels—don't spray your resume everywhere; wrong methods waste your effort.
海投：spray your resume everywhere
充分打磨简历，让企业看到你超预期的经验厚度和职业成熟度。
Polish your resume so employers see your exceptional experience depth and professional maturity.
经验厚度：experience depth
paraphrase: 破局 = 五个动作而不是等运气
Breaking through means five actions, not waiting for luck.
年龄是局限 → 经验是筹码
Age is a limit; experience is your bargaining chip.
scenes.speak: Adjust your mindset and face reality—everyone in this age group is going through it. Change your job-search channels—don't spray your resume everywhere; wrong methods waste your effort. Polish your resume so employers see your exceptional experience depth and professional maturity.

practice: 表达「陷入高不成低不就」
I'm stuck between roles I don't want and roles I can't get.
I've learned to face reality and keep my confidence.
Spraying my resume everywhere won't work; I need a smarter approach.
My age may be a limit, but my experience depth is my strength.
pitfalls: ✕ 直译腔：I can't reach high and won't lower myself.
✓ 地道说法：I'm stuck between roles I don't want and roles I can't get.
高不成低不就直译拗口，用 stuck between 表达卡住的处境。
✕ 直译腔：My way is wrong, and my effort is in vain.
✓ 地道说法：Wrong methods just waste your effort.
in vain 偏书面，口语用 waste your effort。
✓ 地道说法：Be open to a lateral move or a pay cut.
具体化「降低预期」才符合求职语境。
✓ 地道说法：Make your experience depth stand out.
打磨简历是让亮点凸显，直译 thickness 不成立。
shifts: 把求职难拆成定位、偏见、投入三个可解问题
改渠道、降预期、换赛道，主动出击
用经验厚度与职业成熟度弥补年龄局限
footer_notes: ASR 校正：原文「四位方式」按语境校正为「思维方式」，「景力」校正为「简历」，「精力」校正为「尽力」等口语噪声。场景/句子朗读使用 edge-tts，单词发音使用浏览器 Web Speech API。
